```{r functions}
input_file <- knitr::current_input()
rmd_dir <- if (!is.null(input_file)) {
  dirname(normalizePath(input_file, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
} else {
  normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
}

result_dir <- params$result_dir
if (!dir.exists(result_dir)) {
  result_dir <- file.path(rmd_dir, params$result_dir)
}
result_dir <- normalizePath(result_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)

cells <- c("p00", "p10", "p01", "p11")
base_method_order <- c("gOP", "RBC")
base_method_cell_order <- as.vector(outer(base_method_order, cells, paste, sep = "_"))
error_ylim <- c(-0.4, 0.4)

read_cell_csv <- function(file) {
  read.csv(file, check.names = FALSE)
}

get_first_value <- function(x, default = NA) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(default)
  x[1]
}

guess_n_from_file <- function(file) {
  base <- basename(file)
  m <- regexpr("n_?[0-9]+", base)
  if (m < 0) m <- regexpr("_[0-9]+", base)
  if (m < 0) return(NA_integer_)
  as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", regmatches(base, m)))
}

guess_scenario_from_file <- function(file) {
  base <- sub("\\.csv$", "", basename(file))
  base <- sub("^cell_probability_results_?", "", base)
  base <- sub("^cell_probability_true_values_?", "", base)
  if (!nzchar(base)) "default" else base
}

guess_param_set_from_scenario <- function(scenario) {
  out <- scenario
  out <- sub("^rbc_dgm_", "", out)
  out <- sub("^n_?[0-9]+_?", "", out)
  out <- sub("^[0-9]+_?", "", out)
  out <- gsub("(small|normal)([0-9]+)$", "\\1_\\2", out)
  ifelse(grepl("[A-Za-z]", out), out, NA_character_)
}

guess_dgm_from_file <- function(file) {
  if (grepl("rbc_dgm", basename(file), ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    "RBC-DGM"
  } else {
    "gOP-DGM"
  }
}

add_missing_metadata <- function(df, file) {
  scenario <- guess_scenario_from_file(file)

  if (!"scenario" %in% names(df)) df$scenario <- scenario
  if (!"dgm" %in% names(df)) df$dgm <- guess_dgm_from_file(file)
  if (!"param_set" %in% names(df)) {
    df$param_set <- guess_param_set_from_scenario(get_first_value(df$scenario, scenario))
  }
  if (!"n" %in% names(df)) df$n <- guess_n_from_file(file)

  for (cell in cells) df[[cell]] <- as.numeric(df[[cell]])
  df
}

truth_file_for <- function(estimate_file, all_truth_files) {
  target_name <- sub(
    "^cell_probability_results",
    "cell_probability_true_values",
    basename(estimate_file)
  )
  same_dir <- file.path(dirname(estimate_file), target_name)
  if (file.exists(same_dir)) return(same_dir)

  hit <- all_truth_files[basename(all_truth_files) == target_name]
  if (length(hit) > 0) return(hit[1])

  NA_character_
}

make_method_cell_order <- function(methods) {
  known <- intersect(base_method_order, methods)
  extra <- setdiff(sort(methods), known)
  as.vector(outer(c(known, extra), cells, paste, sep = "_"))
}

safe_sample <- function(idx, n) {
  if (!is.finite(n) || length(idx) <= n) return(idx)
  sample(idx, n)
}

summarize_one_file <- function(estimate_file, truth_file, sample_per_group) {
  estimate <- add_missing_metadata(read_cell_csv(estimate_file), estimate_file)
  truth <- add_missing_metadata(read_cell_csv(truth_file), truth_file)

  key_candidates <- c("scenario", "dgm", "param_set", "n", "sim_id", "seed", "id")
  keys <- key_candidates[key_candidates %in% names(estimate) &
                           key_candidates %in% names(truth)]

  truth_keep <- unique(c(keys, cells))
  truth <- truth[, truth_keep, drop = FALSE]
  truth <- truth[!duplicated(truth[, keys, drop = FALSE]), , drop = FALSE]
  names(truth)[match(cells, names(truth))] <- paste0(cells, "_true")

  merged <- merge(estimate, truth, by = keys, all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  methods <- sort(unique(merged$method))
  method_cell_order <- make_method_cell_order(methods)

  summary_rows <- list()
  plot_rows <- list()
  row_id <- 1L

  for (cell in cells) {
    true_col <- paste0(cell, "_true")

    for (method in methods) {
      valid_idx <- which(
        merged$method == method &
          is.finite(merged[[cell]]) &
          is.finite(merged[[true_col]])
      )
      n_zero_excluded <- sum(
        merged[[cell]][valid_idx] <= 0 | merged[[true_col]][valid_idx] <= 0,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
      idx <- valid_idx[
        merged[[cell]][valid_idx] > 0 &
          merged[[true_col]][valid_idx] > 0
      ]
      if (length(idx) == 0) next

      estimate_value <- merged[[cell]][idx]
      true_value <- merged[[true_col]][idx]
      error <- estimate_value - true_value
      abs_error <- abs(error)

      method_cell <- paste(method, cell, sep = "_")

      summary_rows[[row_id]] <- data.frame(
        scenario = get_first_value(merged$scenario, guess_scenario_from_file(estimate_file)),
        dgm = get_first_value(merged$dgm, guess_dgm_from_file(estimate_file)),
        param_set = get_first_value(merged$param_set, NA_character_),
        n = get_first_value(merged$n, guess_n_from_file(estimate_file)),
        file = basename(estimate_file),
        method = method,
        cell = cell,
        method_cell = method_cell,
        n_total = length(valid_idx),
        n_zero_excluded = n_zero_excluded,
        n_values = length(idx),
        mean_true = mean(true_value, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_est = mean(estimate_value, na.rm = TRUE),
        bias = mean(error, na.rm = TRUE),
        abs_bias = abs(mean(error, na.rm = TRUE)),
        mae = mean(abs_error, na.rm = TRUE),
        rmse = sqrt(mean(error^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
        mcsd_error = sd(error, na.rm = TRUE),
        q025_error = unname(quantile(error, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
        q500_error = unname(quantile(error, 0.500, na.rm = TRUE)),
        q975_error = unname(quantile(error, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
        n_error_low = sum(error < error_ylim[1], na.rm = TRUE),
        n_error_high = sum(error > error_ylim[2], na.rm = TRUE),
        row.names = NULL
      )

      sampled <- safe_sample(seq_along(idx), sample_per_group)
      plot_rows[[row_id]] <- data.frame(
        scenario = summary_rows[[row_id]]$scenario,
        dgm = summary_rows[[row_id]]$dgm,
        param_set = summary_rows[[row_id]]$param_set,
        n = summary_rows[[row_id]]$n,
        method = method,
        cell = cell,
        method_cell = method_cell,
        true = true_value[sampled],
        estimate = estimate_value[sampled],
        error = error[sampled],
        row.names = NULL
      )

      row_id <- row_id + 1L
    }
  }

  summary <- do.call(rbind, summary_rows)
  plot_data <- do.call(rbind, plot_rows)

  summary$method_cell <- factor(summary$method_cell, levels = method_cell_order)
  summary$cell <- factor(summary$cell, levels = cells)
  plot_data$method_cell <- factor(plot_data$method_cell, levels = method_cell_order)
  plot_data$cell <- factor(plot_data$cell, levels = cells)

  label <- paste0(
    "n=", get_first_value(summary$n),
    if (!is.na(get_first_value(summary$param_set, NA_character_))) {
      paste0(", ", gsub("_", "", get_first_value(summary$param_set)))
    } else {
      ""
    },
    " (", get_first_value(summary$dgm), ")"
  )

  list(
    file = estimate_file,
    truth_file = truth_file,
    label = label,
    summary = summary,
    plot_data = plot_data
  )
}

plot_error_boxplot <- function(result) {
  plot_data <- result$plot_data
  summary <- result$summary
  need_truncate <- any(summary$n_error_low > 0 | summary$n_error_high > 0)

  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = method_cell, y = error, fill = method)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey35") +
    geom_boxplot(color = "grey20", width = 0.75, outlier.size = 0.4, alpha = 0.9) +
    stat_summary(
      fun = mean,
      geom = "point",
      shape = 21,
      size = 2.2,
      fill = "white",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = subset(summary, n_error_high > 0),
      aes(x = method_cell, y = error_ylim[2], size = n_error_high),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      shape = 21,
      fill = "#C1121F",
      color = "#C1121F",
      alpha = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = subset(summary, n_error_high > 0),
      aes(x = method_cell, y = error_ylim[2], label = n_error_high),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "#1D3557",
      size = 3.5,
      vjust = -0.4
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = subset(summary, n_error_low > 0),
      aes(x = method_cell, y = error_ylim[1], size = n_error_low),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      shape = 21,
      fill = "#C1121F",
      color = "#C1121F",
      alpha = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = subset(summary, n_error_low > 0),
      aes(x = method_cell, y = error_ylim[1], label = n_error_low),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "#1D3557",
      size = 3.5,
      vjust = 1.3
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(gOP = "#2A9D8F", RBC = "#E76F51")) +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 16) +
    guides(size = "none") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "top"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Estimation error of cell probabilities (", result$label, ")"),
      x = "Method_cell",
      y = "Estimated probability - true probability",
      fill = "Method"
    )

  if (need_truncate) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = error_ylim, clip = "off")
  }

  p
}

plot_estimate_boxplot <- function(result) {
  ggplot(result$plot_data, aes(x = method_cell, y = estimate, fill = method)) +
    geom_boxplot(color = "grey20", width = 0.75, outlier.size = 0.4, alpha = 0.9) +
    stat_summary(
      fun = mean,
      geom = "point",
      shape = 21,
      size = 2.2,
      fill = "white",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(gOP = "#2A9D8F", RBC = "#E76F51")) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "top"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Estimated cell probabilities (", result$label, ")"),
      x = "Method_cell",
      y = "Estimated probability",
      fill = "Method"
    )
}

plot_scatter <- function(result) {
  ggplot(result$plot_data, aes(x = true, y = estimate, color = method)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey35") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~ cell, nrow = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(gOP = "#2A9D8F", RBC = "#E76F51")) +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
    theme(legend.position = "top") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Estimated versus true cell probabilities (", result$label, ")"),
      x = "True probability",
      y = "Estimated probability",
      color = "Method"
    )
}

plot_lollipop <- function(result, value, target, title, ylab) {
  df <- result$summary
  df$dev <- abs(df[[value]] - target)
  df$label_y <- ifelse(df[[value]] >= target, df[[value]] + 0.006, df[[value]] - 0.006)
  df$vjust <- ifelse(df[[value]] >= target, 0, 1)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = method_cell, y = .data[[value]], color = method)) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(xend = method_cell, y = target, yend = .data[[value]]),
      linewidth = 2.2,
      lineend = "round",
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 2.7) +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = label_y, label = sprintf("%.4f", .data[[value]]), vjust = vjust),
      size = 3.3,
      color = "grey15"
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = target, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey35") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(gOP = "#2A9D8F", RBC = "#E76F51")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "top"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Method_cell",
      y = ylab,
      color = "Method"
    )
}

estimate_files <- list.files(
  result_dir,
  pattern = "^cell_probability_results.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = isTRUE(params$recursive)
)

if (nzchar(params$file_filter)) {
  estimate_files <- estimate_files[
    grepl(params$file_filter, basename(estimate_files)) |
      grepl(params$file_filter, estimate_files)
  ]
}

estimate_files <- sort(estimate_files)

truth_files <- list.files(
  result_dir,
  pattern = "^cell_probability_true_values.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = isTRUE(params$recursive)
)

if (length(estimate_files) == 0) {
  stop("No cell_probability_results*.csv files found in: ", result_dir, call. = FALSE)
}

set.seed(20260612)
results <- lapply(estimate_files, function(file) {
  truth_file <- truth_file_for(file, truth_files)
  if (is.na(truth_file) || !file.exists(truth_file)) {
    stop("Cannot find truth file for: ", basename(file), call. = FALSE)
  }
  summarize_one_file(file, truth_file, params$plot_sample_per_group)
})

names(results) <- vapply(results, `[[`, character(1), "label")

all_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(results, function(x) x$summary)
)
rownames(all_summary) <- NULL

write_summary_file <- function(summary_data) {
  primary <- file.path(result_dir, "cell_probability_summary.csv")
  fallback <- file.path(rmd_dir, "cell_probability_summary.csv")

  for (file in unique(c(primary, fallback))) {
    ok <- tryCatch({
      write.csv(summary_data, file, row.names = FALSE)
      TRUE
    }, error = function(e) FALSE)

    if (isTRUE(ok)) return(file)
  }

  warning(
    "Could not write cell_probability_summary.csv. ",
    "The summary is still shown in this report.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
  NA_character_
}

summary_file <- write_summary_file(all_summary)
```

# Input Files

```{r input-files}
input_info <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(results, function(x) {
    data.frame(
      scenario = x$label,
      estimate_file = basename(x$file),
      truth_file = basename(x$truth_file),
      n_rows_used_for_summary = sum(x$summary$n_values),
      n_zero_excluded = sum(x$summary$n_zero_excluded),
      plot_sample_per_group = params$plot_sample_per_group,
      row.names = NULL
    )
  })
)

knitr::kable(input_info)
```

# Summary

The table below is calculated on the probability scale. Coverage is not shown because the simulation output currently saves point estimates of cell probabilities, but not cell-probability confidence intervals.

```{r summary-table}
display_summary <- all_summary[
  order(all_summary$scenario, all_summary$cell, all_summary$method),
  c(
    "scenario", "dgm", "param_set", "n", "method", "cell",
    "n_total", "n_zero_excluded", "n_values",
    "mean_true", "mean_est", "bias", "mae", "rmse",
    "mcsd_error", "q025_error", "q500_error", "q975_error"
  )
]

knitr::kable(display_summary, digits = 4)
```

The same summary table is also written to:

```{r summary-file}
if (is.na(summary_file)) {
  "The summary CSV could not be written from this R session."
} else {
  summary_file
}
```

# Scenario Figures

```{r scenario-figures, results='asis'}
for (result in results) {
  cat("\n\n## ", result$label, "\n\n", sep = "")

  cat("\n\n### Cell Probability Summary\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(result$summary[
    order(result$summary$cell, result$summary$method),
    c(
      "method", "cell", "n_total", "n_zero_excluded", "n_values",
      "mean_true", "mean_est",
      "bias", "mae", "rmse", "mcsd_error",
      "q025_error", "q500_error", "q975_error"
    )
  ], digits = 4))

  cat("\n\n### Estimation Error\n\n")
  print(plot_error_boxplot(result))

  cat("\n\n### Estimated Probabilities\n\n")
  print(plot_estimate_boxplot(result))

  cat("\n\n### RMSE\n\n")
  print(plot_lollipop(
    result,
    value = "rmse",
    target = 0,
    title = paste0("RMSE of cell probability estimates (", result$label, ")"),
    ylab = "RMSE"
  ))

  cat("\n\n### Bias\n\n")
  print(plot_lollipop(
    result,
    value = "bias",
    target = 0,
    title = paste0("Bias of cell probability estimates (", result$label, ")"),
    ylab = "Bias"
  ))

  cat("\n\n### Estimated Versus True\n\n")
  print(plot_scatter(result))
}
```
